title: DEP-SEC-001B: Post-#253 residual consolidation and PR fan-out control
intent: After PR #253 (Tier-1 COMPLETE) created Dependabot intake, five version-update PRs (#254-#258) opened within minutes. This sprint inventories those PRs, builds an authoritative DEP-SEC-001 residual disposition matrix, syncs MAINT-DEFER-004 parent state (ACTIVE — TIER 1 COMPLETE, not program RESOLVED), clarifies Tier-1 closeout ≠ parent closeout, adds Residual Obligations Check (Rule 8) to docs/SPRINTS_MAINTENANCE.md, and closes #254-#258 with durable disposition comments deferring work to at most two future tranches (B residual/hygiene, C vitest→vite). No dependency or production code mutation.
